title: Beaver Taxonomy Revealed
hook: Discover the scientific names behind nature's engineers.

scenes.narration: The Eurasian Beaver, Castor fiber, is classified within the family Castoridae, genus Castor, described by Linnaeus in 1758 according to Wood source.
The American Beaver, Castor canadensis, belongs to the family Castoridae, genus Castor, named by Kuhl in 1820 according to Wood source record.
Expert Don E. contributed to the 2016 ITIS report on Castor fiber within the Family Castoridae classification according to source record.
Expert Alfred L. authored the 2016 ITIS entry for Castor canadensis, confirming its placement in Family Castoridae according to source.
Both Castor fiber and Castor canadensis share the genus Castor, established by Linnaeus in 1758 within Castoridae according to ITIS source.

ITIS records list Castor fiber with the authority Linnaeus, 1758, confirming its taxonomic status as Eurasian Beaver according to source.
